title: Broncos DL Matt Henningsen suffered a torn Achilles

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos DL Matt Henningsen suffered a torn Achilles
sources.description: One year ago, on August 7th of 2025, Denver Broncos defensive lineman Matt Henningsen suffered a season-ending Achilles injury. A brutal injury that can end the careers of some players. Henningsen rehabbed, was re-signed by the Broncos, and was able to get back on the practice field and be ready for training camp.
